### Descriptive Variables

```{r}
library(stargazer)

descriptive_vars <- tibble::tribble(
  ~variable,                    ~label,
  "weighted_index_per100k",     "Surveillance index (per 100,000 population)",
  "n_records",                  "Number of Atlas of Surveillance records",
  "n_agencies",                 "Number of distinct agencies",
  "n_tech_types",                "Number of distinct technology types",
  "p_black",                     "Percent Black",
  "p_hisp",                      "Percent Hispanic",
  "p_foreign",                   "Percent foreign-born",
  "med_income",                  "Median household income",
  "med_home_val",                "Median home value",
  "gini",                        "Gini coefficient",
  "p_renter",                    "Percent renter-occupied",
  "poverty_rate",                "Poverty rate",
  "p_edu_hs",                    "Percent high school educated",
  "p_edu_ba",                    "Percent bachelor's educated",
  "pop_den",                     "Population density (per km²)",
  "p_pt_to_work",                "Percent public transit commuters",
  "p_uninsured",                 "Percent without health insurance",
  "mean_violent_rate",           "Log mean violent crime rate (per 100,000)",
  "mean_property_rate",          "Log mean property crime rate (per 100,000)",
  "mean_officers_per_1000",      "Log mean sworn officers per 1,000 residents",
  "total_pop",                   "Total population"
)

descriptive_data <- spatial_df_full_2500 |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(any_of(descriptive_vars$variable)) |>
  as.data.frame()

stargazer(
  descriptive_data,
  type = "text",
  title = paste0("Descriptive Statistics for ", nrow(descriptive_data), " Counties"),
  covariate.labels = descriptive_vars$label[match(names(descriptive_data), descriptive_vars$variable)],
  summary.stat = c("mean", "sd", "min", "max"),
  digits = 3,
  notes = paste0("N = ", nrow(descriptive_data)),
  notes.align = "l"
)
```

```{r}
stargazer(
  descriptive_data,
  type = "html",
  title = paste0("Descriptive Statistics for ", nrow(descriptive_data), " Counties"),
  covariate.labels = descriptive_vars$label[match(names(descriptive_data), descriptive_vars$variable)],
  summary.stat = c("mean", "sd", "min", "max"),
  digits = 3,
  notes = paste0("N = ", nrow(descriptive_data)),
  notes.align = "l",
  out = "figures/descriptive_table.html"
)
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
effects_table <- tibble(
  term = c("Proportion Black", "Proportion Hispanic", "Proportion foreign-born",
           "Median income", "Gini coefficient", "Median home value",
           "Proportion renter-occupied", "Log population density",
           "Log mean violent crime rate", "Log mean property crime rate",
           "Log mean officers per 1,000"),
  direct   = c(-0.477, 0.377, -1.579, 0.0000009, -0.492, 0.0000002, -0.920, 0.103, 0.074, 0.146, 0.626),
  indirect = c(-1.071, 0.848, -3.546, 0.0000019, -1.105, 0.0000006, -2.066, 0.231, 0.165, 0.329, 1.405),
  total    = c(-1.548, 1.225, -5.124, 0.0000028, -1.597, 0.0000008, -2.986, 0.333, 0.239, 0.475, 2.030),
  direct_p   = c(0.007, 0.077, 0.019, 0.647, 0.607, 0.281, 0.010, "<0.001", 0.044, 0.001, "<0.001"),
  indirect_p = c(0.008, 0.079, 0.021, 0.647, 0.618, 0.291, 0.012, "<0.001", 0.050, 0.002, "<0.001"),
  total_p    = c(0.007, 0.077, 0.020, 0.646, 0.614, 0.287, 0.011, "<0.001", 0.047, 0.001, "<0.001")
)

effects_table
```

```{r}
effects_table_formatted <- effects_table |>
  mutate(
    direct_stars = case_when(
      direct_p == "<0.001" ~ "***",
      as.numeric(direct_p) < 0.01 ~ "**",
      as.numeric(direct_p) < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    indirect_stars = case_when(
      indirect_p == "<0.001" ~ "***",
      as.numeric(indirect_p) < 0.01 ~ "**",
      as.numeric(indirect_p) < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    total_stars = case_when(
      total_p == "<0.001" ~ "***",
      as.numeric(total_p) < 0.01 ~ "**",
      as.numeric(total_p) < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    direct_label   = paste0(formatC(direct, format = "f", digits = 3), direct_stars),
    indirect_label = paste0(formatC(indirect, format = "f", digits = 3), indirect_stars),
    total_label    = paste0(formatC(total, format = "f", digits = 3), total_stars)
  ) |>
  select(term, direct_label, indirect_label, total_label)

effects_table_formatted
```

```{r}
stargazer(
  effects_table_formatted,
  type = "html",
  summary = FALSE,
  rownames = FALSE,
  title = "Direct, Indirect, and Total Effects (SARAR Final Model)",
  covariate.labels = c("Variable", "Direct", "Indirect", "Total"),
  notes = "*** p < 0.001; ** p < 0.01; * p < 0.05. Estimates from spatialreg::impacts() with 200 simulation draws.",
  out = "figures/effects_table.html"
)
```

#### Coefficient Plot

```{r}
library(broom)

# Extract coefficients, SEs, and build 95% CIs
coef_plot_data <- extract_spatial_model(sarar_model_final, "Final Model") |>
  mutate(
    ci_lower = estimate - 1.96 * std_error,
    ci_upper = estimate + 1.96 * std_error,
    term_label = case_when(
      term == "p_black"                 ~ "Proportion Black",
      term == "p_hisp"                  ~ "Proportion Hispanic",
      term == "p_foreign"                ~ "Proportion foreign-born",
      term == "med_income"               ~ "Median income",
      term == "gini"                     ~ "Gini coefficient",
      term == "med_home_val"             ~ "Median home value",
      term == "p_renter"                 ~ "Proportion renter-occupied",
      term == "log_pop_den"              ~ "Population density (logged)",
      term == "mean_violent_rate"        ~ "Violent crime rate (logged)",
      term == "mean_property_rate"       ~ "Property crime rate (logged)",
      term == "mean_officers_per_1000"   ~ "Officers per 1,000 (logged)",
      TRUE ~ term
    ),
    category = case_when(
      term %in% c("p_black", "p_hisp", "p_foreign") ~ "Demographic",
      term %in% c("med_income", "gini", "med_home_val", "p_renter") ~ "Property",
      term %in% c("log_pop_den", "mean_violent_rate", "mean_property_rate", "mean_officers_per_1000") ~ "Controls",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)")


# Coefficient plot
coef_plot <- ggplot(
  coef_plot_data,
  aes(x = estimate, y = term_label)
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = "grey55"
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = ci_lower,
      xmax = ci_upper
    ),
    colour = "grey40",
    height = 0.10,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = category),
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    category ~ .,
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y",
    switch = "y"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Demographic" = "#d41243",
      "Property"    = "#7eb0ea",
      "Controls"    = "#d896ff"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Estimated Associations Between County Characteristics and Surveillance Index",
    x = "Coefficient estimate (95% CI)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(
    base_family = "Times New Roman",
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(
      family = "Times New Roman",
      face = "bold",
      size = 15.5,
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(
        t = 5,
        r = 0,
        b = 18,
        l = 0
      )
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 12,
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10.5,
      colour = "black"
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 10,
      colour = "black"
    ),
    strip.placement = "outside",

    strip.text.y.left = element_text(
      family = "Times New Roman",
      face = "bold",
      size = 11,
      angle = 90,
      colour = "black",
      margin = margin(r = 10)
    ),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.25,
      colour = "grey88"
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.25,
      colour = "grey88"
    ),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 15,
      r = 15,
      b = 15,
      l = 15
    )
  )

save_figure(coef_plot, "final_model_coefficient_plot.png",
  width = 9, height = 7.5)
```

### Final Dataset

```{r}
final_model_comparison <- tibble(
  model = c("Final Model (2,500+)", "SARAR, no controls", "Robustness (no threshold)",
            "Robustness (5,000+)", "Robustness (all LEAs, 2,500+)"),
  data  = list(spatial_df_full_2500, spatial_df_full_2500, spatial_df_full, 
               spatial_df_full_5000, spatial_df_full_all)
) |>
  mutate(
    n         = map_int(data, nrow),
    n_zero    = map_int(data, ~sum(.x$weighted_index_per100k == 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
    pct_zero  = scales::percent(n_zero / n, accuracy = 0.3)
  ) |>
  select(model, n, n_zero, pct_zero)

final_model_comparison
```

#### State Coverage

```{r}
state_coverage_final <- spatial_df_full_2500 |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(state = str_extract(NAME, "(?<=, ).*$")) |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarise(
    total_counties = n_distinct(GEOID),
    n_with_documentation = n_distinct(GEOID[weighted_index_per100k > 0]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_coverage = n_with_documentation / total_counties,
    state = fct_reorder(state, pct_coverage)
  )
```

#### Coverage-Cofound

```{r}
check_data_final <- spatial_df_full_2500 |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(state = str_extract(NAME, "(?<=, ).*$")) |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarise(
    mean_index = mean(weighted_index_per100k, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    state_coverage_final |> select(state, pct_coverage),
    by = "state"
  )

# Correlation
cat(
  "Spearman correlation",
  cor(
    check_data_final$pct_coverage,
    check_data_final$mean_index,
    method = "spearman",
    use = "complete.obs"
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Plot
coverage_cofound_plot <- ggplot(check_data_final, aes(x = pct_coverage, y = mean_index)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess") +
  labs(
    title = "Coverage-Cofound",
    subtitle = "Spearman ρ = 0.345",
    x = "AOS documentation coverage (% of counties in each state with documentation)",
    y = "Mean surveillance index"
  ) + 
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")
  )

coverage_cofound_plot
```
